title: cerastium campanulatum subsp. palustre
intro: Cerastium campanulatum subsp. palustre, commonly known as marsh chickweed, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the carnation family that grows in wet environments. It is used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, soothing skin irritations, and calming digestive issues. The health benefits of marsh chickweed include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to heal wounds and alleviate pain. The bioactive constituents of marsh chickweed include flavonoids, tannins, and essential oils, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
